source.name: SPY holdings disclosure (live) + curated quarterly history
source.method: M7 share of S&P 500 float-adjusted market cap; latest summed live from SPY holdings, history hand-curated quarterly.

note_cn: M7 在 S&P 500 总市值中的占比演变。最新一点每次自动更新——把 M7 在 SPY ETF 持仓中的权重(已含 float-adjustment 自由流通调整)相加得到,无需复现 S&P DJI 的闭源调整。历史季度点由三家机构的口径交叉核对策展,相互在 0.5 个百分点内一致。
note_en: M7 share of total S&P 500 float-adjusted market cap. The latest point auto-updates each run by summing the M7's weights in the SPY ETF's holdings (which already embed S&P DJI's float adjustment) — no need to reproduce the closed float-adjustment process. The quarterly history was cross-checked across three independent estimates, which agree to within ~0.5pp.

latest.note: Live reading — M7 share summed from current SPY ETF holdings, whose weights already embed S&P DJI's float adjustment. Auto-updates every run.
